agent_discovery.disabled_reason: Phase 5 structured pointing-pixel output and the complete nonphysical execution adapter are not implemented yet.
agent_discovery.description: Identify the pointed object, register it in the stationary workcell, prepare a controller-owned path preview to a front or top observation pose, and request permission only at the physical-motion boundary. Phase 2 produces a nonphysical proposal and authorization record; approval does not execute motion.
when_to_use: The user points at an object and asks the robot to inspect it from the front or top.
The agent can act through perception and planning without asking for intermediate human planning decisions.
when_not_to_use: Stationary workcell calibration is missing or stale.
The object point cannot be registered with valid RGB-D evidence.
Physical authority or controller safety state is uncertain.
side_effects: Reads camera, spatial, transform, and controller-preview state.
Creates a decision-specific physical-motion authorization request.
Phase 2 does not execute or authorize motion.
